assertions: Cron and interval occurrences are calculated in UTC with explicit timezone handling; the New York spring-forward gap is skipped and both fall-back 01:30 UTC occurrences remain distinct.
Catch-up is bounded by catch_up_max, and misfire=skip and catch_up_max=0 do not admit missed work.
Overlap=skip does not accept a second firing while a prior submission is in flight, and firing outside the effective time window is skipped.
Naive clock inputs are interpreted as UTC and schedule serialization preserves catch-up bounds.
limitations: These deterministic clock and policy tests use in-memory providers. They do not establish PostgreSQL timer authority, competing timer processes, recurrence restart recovery, authority transfer, or live Prefect admission parity.
